name: Britannia cake fruity fun
ingredients: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, EGGS, HYDROGENATED VEGETABLE OIL & REFINED PALMOLEIN OIL, FRUIT PRODUCTS (7.3%) (GLAZED FRUITS (PAPAYA CUTS, SUGAR, COLOURS (124 & 110), PINEAPPLE CUTS) & ORANGE PULP), HUMECTANTS (422 & 420 HIGH MALTOSE E SYRUP, EDIBLE MAIZE STARCH, PENTA CAKE (RAISING AGENTS 1450, 500m, 341, 341m), EMULSIFIERS (472e, 466, 435, STABILIZER (412) & ACIDITY REGULATOR (330)), RAISING AGENTS [34101, 500m) & 4500), NATURE IDENTICAL & ARTIFICIAL (MIXED FRUIT & VANILLA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, CAKE GEL (EMULSIFIERS AND STABILIZERS (471 & 477) AND HUMECTANT (420), IODISED SALT, INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, PRESERVATIVES (202&282), BAKING POWDER, ACIDITY REGULATOR (330), STABILIZER (415) AND COLOUR (102). (Numbers in brackets as per International Numbering System) CONTAINS WHEAT AND EGGS
